Gamma model for SAR intensities (R6)

Source: R/models.R
GammaSAR.Rd

R6 class for the multilook Gamma law \(\Gamma(\mu, L)\); see dgammasar(). The maximum likelihood estimator of \(\mu\) is the sample mean and \(L\) solves \(\log L - \psi^{(0)}(L) = \log\bar z - \overline{\log z}\).

Examples

set.seed(1)
z <- rgammasar(500, mu = 2, L = 4)
m <- GammaSAR$new()$fit(z)
m
#> <Gamma> fitted to n = 500 observations
#>   mu = 1.97692
#>   L = 3.86696
#>   logLik = -666.161
#>   Shannon entropy = 1.33232
m$entropy()
#> [1] 1.332323
m$entropy_variance()
#> [1] 0.001113651
generics::tidy(m)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 4
#>   term  estimate std.error fixed
#>   <chr>    <dbl>     <dbl> <lgl>
#> 1 mu        1.98    0.0450 FALSE
#> 2 L         3.87    0.235  FALSE
